questions.prompt: Which US president issued the Emancipation Proclamation?
questions.fact: It applied only to states in rebellion, so it freed nobody in the border states that had stayed loyal.

questions.prompt: Which type of energy is stored in an object due to its position?
questions.fact: A pumped-storage power station is essentially a giant battery built on this principle, moving water uphill to store it.

questions.prompt: How many holes are played in a standard round of golf?
questions.fact: The number became standard at St Andrews, and was adopted elsewhere largely because of that club's influence.

questions.prompt: Which video game franchise features Master Chief?
questions.fact: It was originally in development for the Macintosh before the studio was acquired and the game became a console launch title.

questions.prompt: Which strait connects the Mediterranean Sea to the Atlantic Ocean?
questions.fact: Without the Atlantic water flowing through it, the Mediterranean would largely evaporate within a few thousand years.

questions.prompt: Who wrote 'A Brief History of Time'?
questions.fact: He was told each equation included would halve sales, so the published book contains only one.

questions.prompt: Which type of software translates one language to machine code line by line at runtime?
questions.fact: It trades speed for flexibility, which is why such languages are often easier to debug but slower to run.
